prompt: Create a production-ready seamless tiling RGB albedo material for a tropical limestone gorge in a cinematic helicopter game. One square image, full bleed, the entire image is the FLAT ROCK SURFACE itself, photographed perfectly orthographically straight-on: no landscape, no perspective, no horizon, no cliff silhouette. Weathered damp tropical limestone, muted warm grey with subtle olive mineral staining, compact broad stone plates separated by irregular thin vertical and diagonal fissures, restrained broken horizontal sedimentary strata. Natural varied erosion and fine pitted mineral grain. Convey 18 metres of rock across the tile, fine detail within broad readable rock forms. The rock is predominantly light-mid grey, softly varied, never black or white. Flat diffuse overcast lighting with NO directional shadows, NO baked highlights or specular, NO strong ambient occlusion. Edge-to-edge perfectly tileable continuous texture with matching left/right and top/bottom, no border or vignette. No leaves, plants, moss tufts, roots, buildings, lettering, labels, watermark, people, weapons. Rich believable hand-crafted game material with painterly-realistic natural detail; visual texture should have the quality of cinematic tropical gorge concept art, but must remain a physically flat reusable albedo tile. Opaque RGB texture, no alpha, no checkerboard. Generate at 1024 by 1024 or nearest supported square size.
